description: Na₂W(OF₂)₂ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pbcn space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six F atoms to form distorted NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent WO₂F₄ octahedra, corners with six NaF₆ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent WO₂F₄ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-65°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.50 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent O and two equivalent F atoms to form NaO₄F₂ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra, corners with six equivalent WO₂F₄ octahedra, and edges with two equivalent NaO₄F₂ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-60°. There are two shorter (2.44 Å) and two longer (2.46 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.35 Å. W is bonded to two equivalent O and four F atoms to form WO₂F₄ octahedra that share corners with eight NaF₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 44-50°. Both W-O bond lengths are 1.78 Å. There are two shorter (1.97 Å) and two longer (2.08 Å) W-F bond lengths. O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom. There are two inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two Na and one W atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one W atom.
